assumptions: Public entrypoints acquire the exclusive writer lock and call reload_state after acquiring it, before refresh or save. Those call sites are not supplied; refresh itself neither acquires the lock nor reloads persisted state.
The supplied helper contracts hold: verify_hashes checks current file contents and missing evidence, local_path enforces repository containment, and atomic writers publish complete files durably.
proposal_gate independently validates current readiness evidence as described in the interface; its implementation is outside this packet.
checks: Accepted phases require nonempty evidence hashes, an unchanged phase contract and matching prerequisite evidence bindings.
The ordered dependency pass propagates stale prerequisite status to accepted descendants before eligibility is computed.
Workflow migration is enforced on initialization, reload and refresh; held and product implementation phases are excluded from eligibility.
Unchanged external blocks and deferred fingerprints suppress automatic retries; declared input and dependency changes affect fingerprints.
Canonical state is saved before derived plans; refreshed plans bind the saved state digest and generation.
State validation requires mission_complete=false and all G1–G18 to remain open.
residuals: The packet reports 197 passing tests and supplies test names, but not test bodies or execution output. This supports the reported control-plane verification only; it does not independently establish the assertions exercised.

Atomic publication is per file, not across the state and all derived views. An ordinary interruption can leave mixed generations until refresh rebuilds them. Consumers must validate freshness against canonical state rather than trust a cached readiness boolean or next-plan file.
Process containment, actual repair execution, approval installation and result-review enforcement are described interfaces, not implementations inspected in this assigned state-refresh scope.
The accepted panel of 192 reports and internal phase acceptance do not establish accounting correctness, scientific completeness or human acceptance.
steps: Reviewed only the supplied state-refresh code, contracts and verification metadata; used no tools.
Traced accepted-evidence invalidation, dependent invalidation, retry eligibility, checkpoint loss handling and derived-plan publication.
summary: AGREE for the bounded state-refresh packet under the explicit interface assumptions. No concrete defect is established by the supplied implementation; this is not approval of omitted controller subsystems or accounting completeness.
